sources.entry: GitX-dev - Fork of Pieter's nice git GUI for OS X. Includes branch/tag sidebar and various fixes. [![Open-Source Software][OSS Icon]](https://github.com/rowanj/gitx) ![Freeware][Freeware Icon]

summary.one_liner: GitX is a gitk-style graphical history browser and diff viewer for git, written for OS X Leopard and later.
summary.what_it_does: GitX provides a native Mac interface for browsing a git repository's history. It lets you view commit history, see a formatted diff for any revision, and search commits by author or subject line. You can browse the full file tree of any revision and preview files in a text view or with QuickLook. Files can be dragged out of the tree view to copy them to the system. The bundled 'gitx' command-line binary accepts most git rev-list arguments, such as --all, path filters, grep-style message search, and revision ranges.
use_cases: browse git commit history on a Mac
view formatted diffs of a revision
search commits by author or message
copy files out of a git revision's tree
filter git history by path or revision range
how_to_run: Open GitX.xcodeproj in Xcode (3.0 or later) and hit Build
Or download the binary release from the project wiki
Install the 'gitx' binary through the app menu to use it from the command line
notable: Native OS X interface with drag-and-drop and QuickLook integration
Command-line 'gitx' binary that accepts most git rev-list arguments
Modeled on gitk but built specifically for Mac
caveats: Requires OS X Leopard or higher; uses Leopard-only features such as garbage collection
README describes the project as still in early phases with a limited feature set
Building from source requires Xcode 3.0 or later
